CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content entries (red/blue coordinates) and explicit origin metadata for the same p0/current/n0 establish identification, organization (origin) and a separate status representation.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to content presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content lines identify coordinates for named entries (red/blue) with explicit referents and attributes.

D.rationale: Content coordinates and separate origin/metadata lines attribute status/organization distinct from content identity for the same referent.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/organization metadata describe how contents are presented/emerge (copied_prior_record, inherited_current, command_estimate) for named referents.
